# WSS Labs

WSS Labs builds managed websites and optional customer automation for local businesses.

Core website offer:
- A working website preview and focused local visibility plan before purchase.
- Managed activation starts at $199 per month after customer approval.
- Includes the finished website on the customer's domain, hosting, security, managed edits and a monthly local visibility report.
- Preview requests do not publish a website or charge a card.
